description: Extracts fields from the known document intake form using OCR.

fieldSchema.name: DocumentIntakeForm
fieldSchema.description: Fields captured from the known intake form.

FormNumber.description: The form identifier printed on the document, usually in the header.

SubmissionDate.description: The date the form was completed or signed.

CustomerName.description: Full name of the customer or applicant.

CustomerReference.description: Customer account, reference, or policy number.

EmailAddress.description: Contact email address supplied on the form.

PhoneNumber.description: Contact telephone number supplied on the form.

AddressLine1.description: First line of the postal address.

AddressLine2.description: Second line of the postal address, if present.

City.description: City or suburb of the postal address.

StateOrProvince.description: State, province, or region of the postal address.

PostalCode.description: Postal or ZIP code of the postal address.

TotalAmount.description: Total monetary amount declared on the form.

Currency.description: Currency code or symbol associated with the total amount.

SignaturePresent.description: True when a handwritten or digital signature appears in the signature block.
